The '''Ozrelanso''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] found in the galaxy. Male members of the species had [[lekku]] that grew on the sides of their skulls.

==Ozrelanso in the galaxy==
During the [[High Republic Era]], the Ozrelanso [[Ratko]] served as a [[bodyguard]] for [[Sullustan]] [[Senator]] [[Tia Toon]]. His large and imposing build made his profession obvious, while Toon claimed Ratko was merely a secretary.<ref name="Rising Storm">''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]''</ref>

During the [[First Order-Resistance War]], [[Plesko Marno]], a former [[Bureau of Ships and Services]] clerk, attended the [[Spice Runners' Den]] on [[Kijimi]] shortly before the world's [[Destruction of Kijimi|destruction]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'', the term "Ozrelanso" is incorrectly spelled "Orzrelanso."<ref name="Rising Storm" />
